card.title: Authority on Paper
card.instruction: Project firm control through titles and procedure, then tighten the formalities whenever anyone tests whether your position has real support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm chairing this meeting under the emergency neighbourhood charter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are only two of us, and I haven't agreed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll record your objection before proceeding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A vote to recognise my authority to record objections.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As emergency neighbourhood chair, I'm assigning you to unblock the communal drain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are only two of us here. I never agreed you were chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you must formally nominate an alternative before withholding cooperation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, an eligibility hearing. As the challenged incumbent, I'll chair it; you'll need someone else to second your nomination.

mechanism: A commands drain work through a claimed chair role and responds to a valid challenge by tightening candidacy eligibility while retaining the chair.
confusable: Unlike merely invoking formal authority, A must add formalities specifically when the claim's real support is tested.
comparison: The neighborhood alternative uses the two-person meeting to obstruct a challenger; the office alternative adds forms to block scrutiny of appointment.
